Adapter modifications in this application:
ES module wrappers converted to classic Worker closures without modifying the
original downloaded assets; in-memory stdc++.h portability umbrella added;
WASI Preview1 filestat timestamp fields corrected in the application adapter.
Original downloaded assets retain SHA-256/byte identities declared in runtime.js.
Only explicitly supplied memory files and stdin/stdout are exposed to programs.
No font files are embedded in this HTML or its offline export.
